turns.prompt: Review README.md for plain-English style. Return structured findings only and do not edit any files.

criteria.structured-findings: Reports material findings with severity, `README.md:line`, a specific issue, and a concrete replacement.
criteria.finds-padding: Identifies the vague marketing language or padded setup wording and suggests direct wording that preserves supported repository facts.
criteria.no-style-churn: Omits harmless personal preferences and does not propose unrelated documentation or code changes.
criteria.report-only: Makes no fixture file changes because the request explicitly asks only for findings.
criteria.host-agent-review: Applies the skill's writing-style reference directly without invoking or requiring a second AI CLI, login, model selection, or remote reviewer.
